name: askrubberduck
description: Plan, challenge, ship, and clean up complex work; the duck is skeptical, dry, and straightforward

interface.shortDescription: Plan, challenge, ship, and clean up complex work; the duck is skeptical, dry, and straightforward
interface.longDescription: The duck listens, judges, and does not flatter: guided planning, independent critique, delivery, decisions, and repository cleanup. Every claim needs evidence; every gate is decorrelated.
defaultPrompt: Use $askrubberduck:duck-run to plan and deliver this change with independent review.
Use $askrubberduck:duck-review to red-team this diff before it ships.
Use $askrubberduck:duck-scan to find what work is ready next.
